title: first driven sprint missed the cost target: 17.5M total, main 49.7%
detail: junit-xml-evidence (first sprint through prusik drive). Target: total <8M, main share <25%. Measured at sprint_complete: total 17.52M (baseline sprint-cost 22.4M, -22%), main 8.70M (baseline 10.1M, -14%), share 49.7%. Post-plan phases cost the main thread little: drive ran building/reviewing/integrating in 3 commands. Main's cost sits pre-plan: briefing 3.71M (brief authoring + an out-of-band permissions fix fb-6569762978f2 that blocked sprint-init), scoping 3.74M and planning 4.46M (two critic REJECT rounds each relayed through main at 100-150K context; peak 148K). Opus also ran scope-critic 1.19M and planner 2.06M. Next lever: drive (or a pre-plan driver) owns scoping->plan the way it owns plan->complete, so critic rounds don't re-read main's context; keep out-of-sprint fixes in their own session.
